result:
If I were able to make a single change to the world, it would be to ensure that everyone has access to clean water and sanitation facilities. Access to safe drinking water and adequate sanitation is a fundamental human right, yet millions of people around the world lack these basic necessities.

The lack of clean water and sanitation leads to numerous health issues such as diarrhea, cholera, typhoid fever, and other waterborne diseases, which are preventable but still cause significant suffering and loss of life, particularly among children. This not only affects individuals' well-being but also hinders economic development, education, and social progress in affected communities.

By addressing this issue, we could significantly reduce the global burden of disease, improve quality of life, and empower communities to thrive without being held back by the lack of access to essential resources. Ensuring universal access to clean water and sanitation would be a monumental step towards creating a healthier, more equitable, and sustainable world.
